## Validation evidence (commands + results)
No shell and no node exist in this runtime, and `security_review_changes` is not part of my tool set, so I did **not** reproduce the 120s abort. What I can run is the diff measurement the card depends on:

1. `project_changes(scope="all", include_patch=false, max_files=200)`

   → **52 files, +32153 / −54**.
3. `project_changes(scope="all", paths=["src"], include_patch=false, max_files=200)`
   → **96 files, +8666 / −915**.

**Split of the reviewed volume: `.codx/` = 77.3% of all added lines; `src/` = 20.8%; everything else = 1.9%.**
Top `.codx` contributors are agent shift transcripts stored as single JSON blobs — `.../Agent: software_developer/Done/shift-2026-11-18-09-45…json` **+3670**, `…/software_developer/Done/shift-2026-11-18-16-07…json` **+3446**, `…/software_developer/Done/shift-2026-11-18-13-02…json`? no — `…/qa/Done/shift-2026-11-18-11-38…json` **+2233**, `…/qa/Done/shift-2026-11-18-16-24…json` **+2006**, plus `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl` **+779**.

Excluding `.codx/` takes the review input from **+41596 → +9443 lines (−77%)** while removing zero product code. That settles remediation option (a) with a number instead of an opinion.

## Second cause, found in the code (this is the part the card was missing)
`codx/junior/engine/git_engine.py` — the only git-diff engine reachable from this root:
- `get_repo_changes(from_branch, to_branch)` at **L626** accepts **no `paths`, no `exclude`, no size cap**. Its signature makes scoping impossible by construction.
- L644–L676: for every changed file it issues **two `exec_command` subprocesses** (`git diff … -- <file>` at L646, `git log --pretty … -- <file>` at L653), then `_get_file_last_modification(file)` per file. At 191 files that is **~400 subprocess spawns** before any line is scanned.
- L679–L691 then runs the *whole* repo diff twice more (diff + `--shortstat`) on top of the per-file loop.

So the 120s abort is **N-files × 2 subprocesses**, not line volume. Filtering `.codx/` cuts N by 27% (191→139 files) but the loop stays linear; the durable fix is to **filter inside the engine before the per-file loop** and to take `paths`/`exclude` in the signature. Recommendation therefore: **(c) both** — exclude `.codx/` from the default review scope *and* move the exclusion into `get_repo_changes` so every caller inherits it, with a reported `scanned` / `skipped` count so a skipped file can never read as a clean pass.

## Correction to the card's remediation note
`.codx/` is **not** in `.gitignore` (29 lines: logs, node_modules, dist, cypress, editor dirs — nothing else). So this cannot be fixed by ignoring it: part of `.codx/` is already **tracked and committed** (the 52 files above include `A` added and `M` modified entries against `HEAD`). Ignoring it now would only hide future churn; the 32k lines already in the diff stay. The exclusion has to be a **review-scope rule**, exactly as the card's option (a) says.

## Not reachable from here (unchanged blocker)
The tool itself is not in this project root: `security_review_changes` has **0 matches** in the reachable tree, and `api/` is outside the tool root, so I cannot patch the gate from here. Acceptance for whoever owns `api/`: `security_review_changes(scope="all")` on 191 files / +41596 must return a verdict **plus scanned/skipped counts** in <120s, and the same call must not report `.codx/` transcripts as reviewable input.

Related: `8a554fa4` (paths resolve against git root → "empty diff"), `94d15daf` (QA gate fail-open on empty filter). Both are the same filter contract; fixing `paths`/`exclude` in one place satisfies all three.

Left in **Review**, not closed and not Code-Reviewed by me.
